raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 14 was delivered twice, with a second load at 05:00 that re-sent 333 rows with txn_ts as epoch milliseconds. The cast fails on those rows, and they would double count if they were parsed. 1768716039000 equals 2026-01-18 06:00:39 UTC, the same instant as the original copy, and the copies differ only in txn_ts format and ingest_ts. The fix parses both timestamp formats and keeps one row per txn_id.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.9,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH parsed AS (SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, ingest_ts, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]+$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts_parsed FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'), dedup AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts ASC, ts_parsed ASC) AS rn FROM parsed) SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, ts_parsed AS txn_ts, CAST(ts_parsed AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM dedup WHERE rn = 1;"}}
